sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0
sources.observed_operation: Handoff: read public specification; no product or remote manifest tested. Critic: opened exact official specification and checked Canvas URI, bounds, Annotation Page, annotations/items distinction, and external resource passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Canvas identifiers are HTTP(S) URIs without fragments; a URI does not ensure perpetual dereferenceability. Canvas width/height define extent; spatial targets stay within bounds. Non-painting annotations use Canvas annotations pages, separate from painting items.
sources.applicability: Stable page targets, region bounds, transcription structure, and the boundary between presentation model and editor/storage.
sources.limits: Does not promise a universal annotation editor, backend, or equal feature support across clients.

sources.title: Presentation API 3 change log
sources.released_version_or_commit: Companion change log for Presentation API 3.0.0
sources.observed_operation: Handoff: read change log; no conversion executed. Critic: opened exact official change log and checked the `otherContent` migration description and transcription motivation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: V2 otherContent/AnnotationList links were replaced with v3 Annotation Pages via Canvas annotations; v3 also changes context and JSON-LD forms.
sources.applicability: Version-aware import and conversion with source identity/version preserved.
sources.limits: Change log does not establish current support in either viewer.

sources.title: IIIF Cookbook recipe 0004: Image and Canvas with Differing Dimensions
sources.observed_operation: Handoff: read public recipe. Critic: opened exact official Cookbook page and checked replacement-image rationale and aspect-ratio restriction.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Canvas space can differ from painted image pixels; the documented replacement case assumes compatible aspect ratio/mapping and warns of distortion otherwise.
sources.applicability: Resolution changes while keeping page geometry in a stable Canvas frame.
sources.limits: Does not solve crop, rotation, page-boundary, aspect-ratio, or content changes.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.observed_operation: Handoff: read W3C Recommendation. Critic: opened exact Recommendation and checked FragmentSelector, Media Fragments `xywh`, and TextualBody language/format passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: FragmentSelector is recommended for a consistent segment description; consumers need not support every selector/media pairing.
sources.applicability: Portable plain-text body and rectangular-region record subset.
sources.limits: Conformance does not prove a particular client can author, render, store, or import it.

sources.title: IIIF Image API 3.0
sources.locator: §§3–6 image requests, size and compliance profiles; §§7–8 CORS/authentication
sources.observed_operation: Handoff: read specification, no endpoint requested. Critic: opened exact official specification and checked static implementation, listed sizes, compliance profile, CORS/authentication context.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A limited/static service need not support arbitrary sizes; service profiles/features and browser access conditions govern requests.
sources.applicability: Per-page external image availability, requested regions/sizes, and access testing.
sources.limits: No collection endpoint or image access was tested.

sources.title: IIIF Content State API 1.0
sources.observed_operation: Handoff: read specification. Critic: opened exact stable specification and checked Manifest/Canvas/region transfer and client-selected mechanisms.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Content State initializes a view/resource; clients choose mechanisms they support and Canvas/region links may require Manifest context.
sources.applicability: Separate page/region deep-link path for compatible viewers.
sources.limits: Not the annotation body or annotation-bundle exchange format.

sources.limits: Release history is not an executed compatibility test.

sources.limits: README statement is not a runtime compatibility test.
